# HRU -> MODFLOW cell map for domain_cascade
# columns: hru_index  cell_index((i-1)*ncol+j)  weight
#
# Two elevation bands of the sagehen grid, each shared by two HRUs:
#   HRUs 2,3 -> upper band (mean land surface 2266.1 m)
#   HRUs 1,4 -> lower band (mean land surface 2058.0 m)
# HRUs 1 and 4 map to identical cells and carry identical elevation, so they are a true twin
# pair; HRU 4 is the control that receives no lateral inflow.
#
# Each HRU's elevation in attributes.nc must be the mean land surface of its own cells: the
# coupler forms lowerBoundHead = h_mf6 - (z_surface_HRU - soil_thickness), so a mismatch puts
# the water table far off the soil column.
#
# NOTE: do not give every HRU its own private set of cells.  That was tried (four disjoint
# bands, elevations matched correctly, boundary head a sane 2.5 m) and SUMMA fails at the
# first step, sub-stepping to <1 s.  The same run succeeds with a whole-grid map whose head
# is an absurd 106 m, and with this two-region map at the same 2.5 m head, so it is not the
# head value: a private cell set makes the explicit head/recharge feedback per HRU tight and
# undamped.  Sharing cells between HRUs damps it.  See domain_cascade/readme.md.
